title: Indian Mushroom Lasagna
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Italian dish, using Indian spices and flavors.

ingredients.name: creamy ricotta substitute
ingredients.notes: use a mixture of yogurt and milk or a non-dairy alternative

ingredients.name: italian seasoning
ingredients.notes: or use garam masala for an Indian twist

instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the umami mushroom sauce and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the creamy ricotta substitute, italian seasoning, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Spread a layer of the sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers: sauce, noodles, ricotta mixture.
Top the final layer of noodles with the remaining sauce and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Let the lasagna rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
